entities.text: Ponaganti Venkat Rao vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the Award passed by the 3rd respondent in Procgs.No.G/204/2017 dt 30.06.2023 on the basis of Memo issued by the 1st respondent bearing No.6613/LAR and R/A2/2015 dt 06.07.2015 in granting the compensation in acreage basis without granting in squared yard basis for the petitioners land in Sy.No.119 including house property bearing No.960/1 admeasuring 4954 sq.yards at Dubbapalli Village H/o Chelpur Village, Ghanpur Mandal, Jayashankar Bhupalpally District as illegal, arbitrary, unconstitutional and contrary to the provisions of LAR and R Act and consequently direct the 3rd Respondent to pay the compensation to the petitioner for the above mentioned property as per the Award in squared yard basis without reference to Memo No.6613/LAR and R/A2/2015 dt 06.07.2015..."

2. Heard both sides and perused the material on record.
3.

When the matter is taken up for hearing the learned Counsel for the petitioners would submits that the lis in the writ petition is squarely covered by orders of this Court in W.P.No.18592 of 2023 and batch, dated 04.07.2024 and requested to pass similar order in this writ petition.
The same SK,J is not disputed by the learned Assistant Government Pleaders appearing for the respondents.

4. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, the orders passed by this court in the writ petition referred above and for the reasons alike, the present writ petition is disposed of in terms of orders passed in W.P.No.18592 of 2023 and batch, dated 04.07.2024.
5.

Accordingly, this writ petition is allowed by setting aside the Award proceedings No. G/204/2017,
dated 30.06.2023 passed by the respondent No.3 insofar as the calculation to the extent of the land over and above 4954 sq. yards.

The respondents are directed to recalculate the land acquisition compensation for the entire land of the petitioners on square yard basis without taking into account the impugned memo No.6613/LAR & R/A2/2015 dated 06.07.2015 and pay the differential compensation amount within two (2) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
